$comment: Pinned identity of the Nim compiler artifacts under vendor/nim. `npm run assets:nim` verifies against this file and fails rather than re-pinning, so a moved upstream cannot quietly become the new truth. Re-pin deliberately with `npm run assets:nim -- --update`.

source.license: MIT, for the project's glue and patches; the compiler it contains is Nim 2.2.4, also MIT
source.note: Not built here, and the only artifact in this repository that is neither written here nor shipped by @live-codes/clang-wasm. The bytes are pinned so that the dependency is at least immutable and traceable; see the README for what building it in-house would take.
